note: SysEx messages are slot-0 'reply' (cmd 03) bodies as read from the device; vw2 is what the vendor editor saved for that preset. The .vw2 carries no slot number and no command. 'negative' lists inputs that a conforming reader MUST reject: the .vw2 reader for 'vw2' items, the SysEx reader (reply/set parser) for 'sysex' items.

not a reply/set command (offset 6 = 02, a Get, with a full-size body)
a data byte with the high bit set (offset 20 = 80)
